problem: Says the gate, merging and dismissed non-issues key on axis/facet/handles "never on your `claim` wording". For an unkeyed finding (facet `other`, or an open axis) merging and non-issue keys fall back to the exact claim, so rewording it splits the finding and lets a dismissed one re-surface.
replacement: The facet, the axis and the handle set are the finding's **identity**: the reproduction gate, cross-run merging and dismissed non-issues all key on them, not on your `claim` wording. Only a finding with facet `other` (or on an open axis) falls back to its exact `claim`, so rewording it makes it a new finding.
